summary: Salary Slip (Month-wise) feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests PASS (Milan Jul-2026 API+PDF-content decode, Chirag Jul-2026 API+PDF-content decode, 400 on missing fields, 404 on non-existent employee, doc persisted in db.documents with letter_type='salary_slip', existing /api/documents/generate offer_letter regression still works). Frontend: full UI flow works — login as renish, navigate to /admin/employee/1, click Documents tab, salary-slip-section visible, month/year selects populated, Generate Slip button triggered PDF download 'Milan Tandel_Salary Slip - Jul-2026.pdf', toast 'Salary slip generated!' shown, and 'Salary Slip - Jul-2026' appears in Generated Documents list. Milan Jul 2026 PDF decoded values match expected exactly: MILAN TANDEL, Jul-2026, LWP 4.00, Gross 55564.51, Total Deduction 200.00, Net 55364.51, 'In Words: Rupees Fifty Five Thousand Three Hundred And Sixty Five Only'.
action_items: num2words==0.5.14 was pip-installed at runtime but NOT frozen into /app/backend/requirements.txt — add it there to avoid a broken deploy after container rebuild.

Minor: In Words rounds via int(round(net)) so 55364.51 becomes 'Fifty Five Thousand Three Hundred And Sixty Five'. That drops the paise. If HR wants paise ('and Fifty One Paise') in-words too, extend _rupees_in_words. Not a bug per spec.

PT (P.T.) row emits value 200.00 for Milan but Chirag PDF still writes P.T. 200.00 too — this is because get_salary applies PT based on gross bracket; if Chirag was expected to have '0' PT per data, verify PT config. (Not flagged as bug per your note: PT is data-driven.)
Route mismatch: navigating directly to /login shows blank page (route not registered — only '/' route serves LoginPage). Not part of this feature; call it out separately for main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~8100 lines — the new endpoint (~180 lines) makes modularisation more urgent. Consider extracting documents routes to a router file.

Salary slip endpoint calls internal get_salary(year, month, user) which recomputes salary for ALL active employees to fetch one row — O(N) per slip. For a company with hundreds of employees this is wasteful. Refactor get_salary to expose a per-employee helper.
Line 7104 has dead code: 'att_response = await get_attendance_admin(...) if False else None' — remove.
Deductions list conditionally swaps 'CPF (Company)' with 'Oth. Ded' via a tuple ternary — readable but fragile. Prefer explicit if/else with append.

Empty page issue: the front-end has no /login route (only /). Verified /login yields empty
. Users bookmarking /login will hit a blank screen (no 404, no redirect).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Salary Slip endpoint at POST /api/documents/salary-slip. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_salary_slip.py (pytest, 6 tests). PDF content extractable via pdfplumber (installed). Milan (emp 1) Jul 2026 canonical numbers: Gross 55564.51, Total Deduction 200.00, Net 55364.51, LWP 4.00. Frontend: use / (not /login) to reach LoginPage. Native <select> elements for month/year — use page.select_option with value string ('7', '2026'). Downloads triggered directly by button click via handleGenerateSalarySlip.
